questions.text: Do you live in a house or a flat?
questions.say: Good evening. My name is Isabella, and I'm your examiner today. This is the Speaking test. In this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself. Let's talk about your home. Do you live in a house or a flat?

questions.text: Which room in your home do you like most? Why?

cueCard.topic: Describe a time when you helped someone.
cueCard.explain: and explain how you felt about helping this person.

questions.text: Describe a time when you helped someone.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time when you helped someone. You should say: who you helped; when and where it happened; what you did to help; and explain how you felt about helping this person.

questions.text: Do you often help people in this way?
questions.say: Thank you. Do you often help people in this way?

questions.text: Why do some people volunteer to help others without being paid?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a time when you helped someone, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all helping in the community. Why do some people volunteer to help others without being paid?

questions.text: Should schools ask students to do volunteer work?
questions.say: Should schools ask students to do volunteer work?

questions.text: Do you think people help each other less than they used to?
questions.say: Do you think people help each other less than they used to?

questions.text: What kinds of help should governments give to older people?
questions.say: Now let's talk about help from governments and businesses. What kinds of help should governments give to older people?

questions.text: Do large companies have a responsibility to help the community?
questions.say: Do large companies have a responsibility to help the community?

questions.text: Is it better to give money to charity or to give your time?
